summary: Pumping without a source track: a volume shape ducks the part on every beat and swells back (house, EDM pads); with a kick or drum track to key from, chain/sidechain-duck
body: A fake duck with Tidal, for when there's no track to key from (or a steady pump on every beat is the sound wanted): a quarter-note volume shape (rate index 3), sharp slope. openDAW's compressor does have a real side-chain input: with a kick or drum track, use chain/sidechain-duck.
The duck must fall on the kick: if it swells on the beat instead, set offset to 180. amount sets the depth. Not on the drums themselves: on pads, bass, keys.

track.about: the part to put it on, or master
